description: Register an agent (ES256 P-256 public JWK JSON string + optional payment rails + destination). BEFORE: list ~/.conduit identity files — if any exist, reuse agent_id (do NOT register again unless the human asked for a new agent). AFTER: write persist.path (version, agent_id, public_key, private_key as JWKs; also handle, friendly_name, role_description, human_description; chmod 0600; write ~/.conduit/active). Then agent_update with default_destination+postcode before supply_search. Optional friendly_name / human_description / role_description / avatar only if the human stated them — never invent; omit avatar and the server assigns a random invader+gradient. Omit handle to auto-generate (e.g. parcel-watcher-12).

avatar.description: Identity mark. Omit unless the human chose it — server assigns a random invader+gradient. { kind:"glyph", glyph:"invader"|emoji, tint?:invader color, gradient } or { kind:"image", src }. Tint only for invader. Do not store in the credentials file.

default_destination.description: Where orders ship. postcode + country is enough for supply_search and delivery estimates; add address, locality and region so checkout links arrive prefilled.

address.description: Street address. Needed for checkout to prefill

email.description: Buyer contact email for the merchant order

locality.description: City. Needed for checkout to prefill

name.description: Recipient name; many merchants require it to fulfil

postcode.description: Postal / ZIP code. Enough for search and delivery estimates

friendly_name.description: Human-facing label (≠ handle), e.g. EU Restock Bot

handle.description: Optional display handle (lowercase kebab); omit to auto-generate e.g. parcel-watcher-12

human_description.description: Description shown to humans on the org dashboard

payment_rails.description: Optional rail keys to seed, e.g. ["x402"]

public_key.description: ES256 P-256 public JWK as a JSON string (kty=EC, crv=P-256, x, y). Not PEM, hex, or base64url-wrapped JSON. Keep the matching private JWK only in ~/.conduit/{handle}.credentials.json.

role_description.description: Self-instruction for this agent only, e.g. manage EU supplies

name: agent_create
title: Create agent profile
